label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Some good news: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November, and I’m genuinely delighted to welcome her.

Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE), with nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. Having her on board gives us the capacity we’ve been missing, and means I’ll no longer be trying to cover every site visit, calculation and drawing myself. If you meet her on site, please say hello.

It’s also time I acknowledged that September and October weren’t good enough. Beam calculations and drawings were taking five to six weeks. Several clients waited far too long, and some were understandably unhappy. The criticism, including a sharp review, was hard to read but fair.

Those delays were my fault. I said yes to too much work on my own.

By October I was out on visits during the day and doing calculations until midnight. My wife started calling the office “the other house”. That wasn’t sustainable, and it certainly wasn’t the service you should expect.

One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting and the steel already ordered. We got their calculations to them in three days once it became urgent, but only after they’d chased twice. They shouldn’t have had to.

**With Priya joining, our target is now 10 working days for beam calculations and drawings.** That’s a target, not a promise that every job will be identical, but it’s what we’re working towards.

There’s one other change: **first site visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95**, deducted from our fee if you go ahead. Around a third of free visits haven’t led to a job, so we need to make that time sustainable too.

**Any visit already booked when this post is published stays free, whatever its date.**

If you’re waiting for work from us now, your job is moving forward. Please message me directly for an update.

Thank you for your patience. I’m really looking forward to this next chapter—and to giving you a better service.
